dedupe_keys.name: ijglobal green street infrastructure infrastructure and energy finance transactions assets and funds data

description: IJGlobal's infrastructure and energy finance database, now sold as Green Street Infrastructure (ijglobal.com leads to the same product), tracks infrastructure deals through their life cycle, combining IJGlobal's transaction data and news with Green Street's research and predictive analytics. Coverage: global infrastructure and energy finance; the data cover transactions, assets, funds and market participants (lenders, arrangers, advisers), with live league tables by deal value and volume, public and private market data, forecasts and verified sales comparables, an asset-for-sale radar, and research across ten sectors including data centres, airports, railroads, toll roads, towers, healthcare, senior and student housing, cold storage and contractors. Format and access: a subscription web platform with research, data and analytics, news and league tables; demos and a brochure on request. Licence: commercial subscription terms, not read. Caveats: the page read is a product overview, so the database fields, the number of transactions and the history covered were not checked; prices are not published. Simulation uses: project pipelines, ownership and financing of infrastructure assets for investment-aware capacity planning and for tracing planned assets into network models. Related records: BloombergNEF energy transition data (data-bloombergnef-energy-transition-research-and-data), which also tracks energy investment deal flow.
